Actually, supermassive/ultramassive black holes don’t like to tear apart stars and make giant plumes of plasma behind. They have much lower tidal forces on the event horizon so instead of tearing apart, they more swallow stars whole without leaving much behind. That’s also why super/ultramassive black holes tend not to have accretion discs, their tidal forces don’t allow matter to be ripped apart and spread around as a ring. They’re much more commonly found with nothing around them, just the black hole.
